# FLX-3672: the response estimates a plan records are not well formed

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

plan.json holds the estimates the pinned profile gave the response families under responseEstimates, and apply and replay read them back. A plan edited by hand, or written for other families than the Simulation declares now, is refused rather than applied.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3672
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
